5.finding: On Crossbones Isle, tear a Wanted Poster off a wall. Follow its Sprite Treasure Map, dig at the marked spot with your pickaxe, then open the buried Sprite Chest. The Sprite you receive is random.

Fortune.bonus: Highlights chests close to you, in addition to the base ability.

Cursed.bonus: Improves rare-variant odds. Being in water deals damage while this Sprite is equipped.

Gold.bonus: Adds elimination XP for your Sprite.

halfpeeld.does: Shows elimination locations on your map.
halfpeeld.levels: Each level expands its detection radius.

repete.does: Speeds up reloading; some reloads return ammunition.

barryofish.does: Lowers stamina use when sprinting through water.
barryofish.levels: At maximum level, also provides Slap.

wayfinder.does: Detects nearby Sprites and improves buried-chest loot.

kelper.does: Heals you gradually while you are in water.

exmarks.does: Locates Wanted Posters and Treasure Maps.
exmarks.levels: At maximum level, produces a Treasure Map.

plundarrgh.does: Chest openings boost movement and pickaxe speed.

lilsquibbly.does: Leaping into a fishing hole catches fish and extra loot.

lilflacko.does: Landing sends out a shockwave that pushes enemies away.
lilflacko.findingExtra: Another route: defeat A$AP Rocky on The $.$. Rocky for a chance at his Lil' Flacko drop.

chester.does: Prevents fall damage and can add loot to chests.

sweetdreams.does: Level-ups give random loot; the maximum level releases Mythic items.

transpondersnail.does: Item pickups yield extra resources. Teammates carrying this Sprite also receive a share.
transpondersnail.levels: The resource bonus grows as it levels up.
